candidates.finding: Check if two concurrently connected operational seats can both claim one pending board card due a split check/update operation.
candidates.screening_result: Current Manyhands main@35cffa653b83101d67c6706f3561b00251614621 is MIT, source drifted from Index. First-party server.js handleClaimCard performs check claimedBy, conditional writeBoard, and 200/409 response inside one withWriteLock callback. Existing claim decision already serializes concurrent same-card same-process requests; no first-party duplicate win evidenced. No native tests executed; no changes.

candidates.finding: Check if a later shorter Retry-After can replace a shared provider cooldown, allowing colliding concurrent loops to retry early.
candidates.screening_result: Current Ylva main@46378bd1663ef998ac695b2e4f76e337fb35d97f Apache-2.0, source drift. src/http.rs RetryCooldown::note_retry_after locks shared Mutex and only updates if current deadline is earlier than the new deadline; wait_until_open loops until the current shared deadline. Therefore shorter retry does not shorten cooldown. No native test or fix performed.

candidates.finding: Check if two concurrent new_workspace creation requests can attach distinct child agents to one uninitialized or shared worktree.
candidates.screening_result: Current Kandev main@94e35cd2234608185643c91e9f1aeebf1f1956ca AGPL-3.0, substantial source drift. Current first-party coordination.md documents new_workspace isolation and external_id idempotent existing-work response, but neither demonstrates a concurrent two-task collision or its absence in the executor. No supported native reproducer or proven defect. CONTRIBUTING requires manual feature testing and issue discussion before architecture/new execution boundary changes. No patch or third-party write.
candidates.blocker: No deterministic first-party concurrent new_workspace duplicate-ownership reproduction, and Kandev CONTRIBUTING demands manually tested changes and prior issue discussion for new execution-boundary or architecture modifications; fresh source SHA and target-specific authorization required.

candidates.finding: Check if two concurrent tasks.claim MCP calls can both succeed on the same pending task despite a transactional claim contract.
candidates.screening_result: Current Agent Harness Kit main@cf46b89d75dfbffb5b34b47d709fb28d149942a9 Apache-2.0, drift. HarnessDB.claimTask calls TaskRepository.claim within driver.transaction. Actual TaskRepository.claim is one SQL UPDATE ... WHERE id = ? AND status = 'pending', affected-row-gated, increments claim_generation, and fails subsequent competing claim. The predicted check-then-update gap is already prevented. No native test or patch run.

candidates.finding: Check whether native failure or panic during rootedMutationGate ownership leaves the process-wide mutation gate unavailable to later supported writes.
candidates.screening_result: Current Snow Core main@1047f8e933442fa156d53ca78aa869792e9f9188 is MIT; drift from Index pin. lockRootedMutation in root_mutation.go returns a release closure and removes the channel token on immediate cancellation. Both built-in edit.go and write.go defer unlock() immediately after successful acquisition, so subsequent errors and normal panic unwinding do not strand the process-wide gate. No failing supported counterexample and no patch or native test executed.
